title: Wally's Weenie Wagon + Cave Point E-Bike Picnic
why: Fall visitors in Jacksonport who want an easy afternoon: local lunch, short e-bike ride, picnic. Shareable with Wally's.
hook_options: Lunch from Wally's. Picnic at Cave Point.
The easiest fall lunch in Jacksonport.
Hot dogs, e-bikes, and a lake view.
caption: Our favorite lazy fall afternoon: pick up lunch from @wallysweeniewagon (right next door to our shop), hop on a fat tire e-bike, and ride about 4.5 miles to a picnic table at Cave Point County Park. Two hours is plenty. Food photos courtesy of Wally's Weenie Wagon. Save this for your trip and send it to whoever's buying the fries. #DoorCounty #Jacksonport #CavePoint #EBikeRental #DoorCountyFall

slides.headline: Lunch from Wally's. Picnic at Cave Point.
slides.body: Wally's is right next door to our shop. Grab lunch, ride 4.5 miles, and eat with the lake in front of you.

slides.headline: Rent the bike.
slides.body: Fat tire e-bikes, ready at our Jacksonport shop. Book online at doorcountykayaktours.com.

slides.headline: Start on Hwy 57.
slides.body: Fat tire e-bikes are $30 an hour or $60 for two. Wally's Weenie Wagon is right next door.

slides.headline: Order at Wally's.
slides.body: Breakfast wraps, scones and lattes, plus Chicago dogs, gyros and burgers. Ask for it to go.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/Wallys Weenie Wagon (permission 2026-10-26)/wallys-October-16-2026.jpg

slides.headline: Pack it like a picnic.
slides.body: Lunch, napkins, water, a trash bag and a sweatshirt for the lake wind. Cave Point has tables, so skip the blanket.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/Wallys Weenie Wagon (permission 2026-10-26)/wallys-October-23-2026.jpg

slides.headline: Ride to Cave Point.
slides.body: About 4.5 miles from the shop. Take the two-hour rental so you have time to sit and eat.

slides.headline: Cave Point County Park.
slides.body: Picnic tables, grills and a shelter, right by the cliffs.

slides.headline: Keep back from the edge.
slides.body: Rocks are slippery when wet, and the water is shallow. No jumping. Pack your trash out.
